summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Bhoomi Groups website with multi-language support and blog CMS. All major functionality working correctly including homepage sections, blog management, admin dashboard, and responsive design.

design_issues.issue: Meta elements (author, category, published date) not displaying properly on blog detail page

passed_tests: Admin authentication and JWT token verification
Blog CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
Homepage loading with all sections (hero, about, products, blog, testimonials, FAQ, forms)
Multi-language toggle (English/Hindi) working across all pages
Blog listing page with 3 published posts
Blog detail page navigation and back functionality
Admin dashboard with create/edit/delete post functionality
Responsive design on mobile (390x844), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1920x1080)
Navigation anchor links (About, Products, Contact sections)
Zoho forms integration (Help Desk and Dealer Enquiry forms)
Footer with group companies (CRI Groups, Plasto, Texmo, Lubi)
Brand color scheme implementation (Deep Blue #3A339B, Orange #E67E22, Beige #F5F0E5)

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (all major features working, minor meta display issue)
